text:
Jared Kim: kicking off the CloudMarket + Integration go-live thread. Need owners for: launch blog, marketplace asset pack, micro-bench narrative, webinar logistics, and inbound lead routing. Short replies pls. :wave:
Zoe Park: Ill take the blog + social snippets. Recommend publish 7 days before live to give partner share window. Draft deadline: Nov 3.
Marta Silva: Marketplace assets owner here. Checklist: 1200x628 co-brand hero, logo (png + svg), 200-250 word description, two screenshots (console & integration flow), short privacy blurb. Assets due Oct 27.
Chris Nguyen: I can do the benchmark narrative. Keep it tight: p50 latency @512, p95 at 1k, sustained throughput (requests/s) on the recommended 4-GPU profile, and $/1k tokens. Methods = one-paragraph, link to perf repo. Need infra lock to run numbers.
leo (partner): Partner will supply quote, headshot, and a 30s promo clip by Oct 20. We can also supply a co-host for LinkedIn Live if helpful.
Jared Kim: Webinar suggestion: Nov 10 @ 16:00 UTC. Run-of-show proposal: 1) 5m host intro, 2) 20m live integration demo, 3) 10m bench highlights, 4) 15m partner/customer panel, 5) 10m Q&A & CTA. Dry run Nov 6. Who will moderate?
Zoe Park: I can moderate if needed. Also will produce email copy + 3 short social posts (announce, reminder, last call).
Marta Silva: Marketplace legal needs a one-sentence data residency note. Leo, can your privacy team sign off quickly?
leo (partner): Yes, will review legal blurb by Oct 23.
Chris Nguyen: For bench runs I propose using the "redwood-balanced" profile for parity. If everyone agrees I'll start runs Monday and target numbers by Oct 25.
Jared Kim: Routing plan draft: marketplace leads -> HubSpot form -> tag cloud_market_launch -> set product_interest + lead_age -> route to regional SDR queue. SLA: contact within 24h, mark MQL when org_size>50 OR title contains "Engineer"/"Product".
Zoe Park: UTM scheme we should standardize: utm_source=cloudmarket, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloudlaunch-nov. Use it across blog, emails, partner assets.
Marta Silva: Asset upload sheet will be shared (CSV) and a public S3 drop link for partners. I'll add validation rules (size, format).
Chris Nguyen: Small snippet for the methods section to use in blog/webinar slides: ```We ran 5 trials per config using the Redwood inference harness (repo link), reporting median latency and cost normalized to 1k tokens. Instances: 4xA10G, sequence length=512/1024.```
Jared Kim: Action owners recap: Zoe = blog + promo copy + host, Marta = marketplace assets + legal coord, Chris = bench + slides, Leo = partner quote + promo clip. I'll make a GDoc with deadlines and ping the partner.
leo (partner): :thumbsup: we'll get assets and clip in the timeline.
campaign-bot: Reminder created: "CloudMarket Integration dry run" scheduled for 2024-11-06 15:00 UTC.
Jared Kim: Thanks all — syncing Friday to confirm slide owners and final infra choices.
